annotations.title: Is demand for this real, or is search moving for everyone?

description: Use when the user asks whether interest in a product, category or trend is really growing, or wants to know if a rise in search is more than noise before investing in it. Returns the category's year-on-year search change against an everyday basket of ten unrelated searches (its growth beyond the market), a volume band, and whether SEC 10-K filings confirm the direction, the costly-to-fake check. Changes and bands only, never monthly volumes. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.07 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/demand-check.json

also.description: Optional: up to 4 more keywords for the same category, comma-separated.
